line_move_yardstick_v1_model_only_vs_alw.classification_evidence: Clean comparison: neither side uses any post-opener information (raw model-only pick vs always-take-the-favourite). Interval spans zero and probability_positive is near 0.5, so this is unresolved_below_power, not a refuted mechanism (AGENTS.md: an interval crossing zero never closes a signal on its own) and not a positive control. Sign flips season to season (positive 2020/2024/2025, negative 2021/2022/2023) with no stable direction.
line_move_yardstick_v1_model_only_vs_alw.description: Paired week/season-block bootstrap on line_move_toward_pick (opener->close move toward the pick, points), same 2020-2025 graded games used by the LOSO pick-probability fit.
line_move_yardstick_v1_model_only_vs_alw.notes: week-block 95% CI [-0.1326, 0.1140], week-block probability_positive 0.4385. Decisive games 557, decisive mean -0.018 pts, model-only wins 305-252 favourite wins. 12 pick'em games excluded. Per-season points: 2020 +0.092, 2021 -0.091, 2022 -0.106, 2023 -0.100, 2024 +0.048, 2025 +0.119. On this yardstick the raw model shows no distinguishable line-move edge over simply following the favourite, consistent with the owner's 2026-09-16 diagnosis that the served model adds little beyond line-following; remains open per AGENTS.md, not closed.
line_move_yardstick_v1_model_only_vs_alw.plain_summary: On this low-variance opener-to-close yardstick, picking the model's raw favourite lands no differently than always picking the market's favourite -- the effect is a coin flip and swings sign by season.

line_move_yardstick_v1_opener_only_vs_mo.classification_evidence: Uncontaminated substitute for served_vs_model_only. opener_only_probability is a fresh LOSO logit refit of the same pipeline restricted to (model_logit, composition_flag_sum), dropping the two market-move terms so no post-opener information enters either side. Interval crosses zero (probability_positive 0.8805, leaning positive but not resolved), so unresolved_below_power; not a refuted mechanism and not a positive control.
line_move_yardstick_v1_opener_only_vs_mo.description: Paired week/season-block bootstrap on line_move_toward_pick (opener->close move toward the pick, points), same 2020-2025 graded games used by the LOSO pick-probability fit.
line_move_yardstick_v1_opener_only_vs_mo.notes: week-block 95% CI [-0.0427, 0.1323], week-block probability_positive 0.8325. Decisive games (sides differ) only 323 of 1503 -- the reduced fit agrees with model-only on most games; decisive mean +0.203 pts, opener-only wins 151-172 model-only wins (model-only actually wins more decisive games despite the higher pooled mean, driven by size not count). line_move_yardstick_v1_opener_only_vs_mo.plain_summary: Adding the pregame situational flags to the raw model, with no post-opener market-move term, leans toward a small opener-to-close edge over the raw model alone, but the interval still crosses zero.

line_move_yardstick_v1_served_vs_always_.classification_evidence: CONTAMINATED comparison for the same reason as line_move_yardstick_v1_served_vs_model_only: the served side's market-move term is built from post-opener information that overlaps the opener-to-close yardstick. 12 pick'em games (tue_open_home_spread == 0) excluded, always-favourite undefined there. Interval excludes zero but the mechanism is confounded, so unresolved_below_power; see opener_only_vs_always_favourite for the uncontaminated substitute.

line_move_yardstick_v1_served_vs_model_o.classification_evidence: CONTAMINATED comparison, not admissible for closing anything: the served four-term probability's FIT_FEATURES include market_move_toward_home/market_move_available (leader_median_through_sunday_prekick_v1), sharp-book movement measured after the opener and up through Sunday pre-kick. The served side is compared against a yardstick built from that same opener-to-close window, so the positive result is partly circular, not evidence the served combination adds pregame value. Interval excludes zero but the mechanism is confounded, so this stays unresolved_below_power; see opener_only_vs_model_only for the uncontaminated substitute.
